thread:
maria: Heads-up: Nvidia just requested moving H200 marketplace announce up by 2 weeks. This conflicts with Gaudi soft-launch timing. Need cross-org decision before tomorrow EOD. @kevin @jia
kevin: On it. Can we keep the H100/H200 stack separate from Gaudi rollouts? What's the vendor ask exactly?
jia: They want earlier press embargo lift: proposed 2025-05-12 vs our planned 2025-05-26. Risk: SI certs not done, marketplace images not validated.
raj: If we move, we need to change canary route + cert gating. Timeline quick sketch:
```
- 05/02: cert freeze
- 05/06: canary images staged
- 05/10: marketplace listing ready
```
raj: Sales + partners need final content for co-announcement. We can compress but need vendor comms. @vendor-bob can Nvidia commit to extended lab access for partner SIs?
vendor-bob: We can extend lab access by a week and bump firmware drop earlier. Need Redwood to accelerate compatibility tests. Will share build id tomorrow.
kevin: We have a failing perf regression on B200 quant kernels that blocks our sw roll. ETA fix ~72h. If that's not resolved, we should hold H200 public announce.
maria: Proposal: split announcement — 'availability' for H200 on enterprise reserved plans on 05/12 (no press), general marketplace listing 05/26. That gives SI and docs runway. Thoughts?
jia: :thumbsup: I like split. Ops: make a stub marketplace listing (no pricing) to reserve SKU and tag 'early-access'.
raj: Agree. I will prep partner comms. Can we get a statement for SI playbook and timelines by EOD?
vendor-bob: Confirming lab access + build id: nvidia-h200-bundle-20250501. Will send details to @maria and @jia.
kevin: I'll push a hotfix to quant kernels, will post CI status in #eng-runtime. If green, we can greenlight enterprise availability.
maria: Great — action items:
- @kevin finish fix + report
- @jia create stub listing + canary route
- @raj draft partner note
- @vendor-bob share build + lab creds
We reconvene 05/02 9am PT. :calendar:
bot-deploy: Reminder set: 2025-05-02 09:00 PT — vendor-announcement-sync (recurring: none).
